title: Tangent vectors at a rational point as functionals on the cotangent space
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a $k$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $x\in X$ be a point whose residue field [def-weil-residue-field] satisfies $\kappa(x)=k$ (the map $k\to\kappa(x)$ is an isomorphism); let $\mathfrak m_x$ be the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and write $a\mapsto\bar a$ for the residue map $\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\kappa(x)=k$. Let $T_{X/k,x}$ be the tangent space with its $k$-vector space structure [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space], whose elements are morphisms of $k$-schemes $\theta:\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon]\to X$. For $\theta\in T_{X/k,x}$ let $\theta^\sharp:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to k[\epsilon]$ be the map induced by $\theta$ on stalks at the closed point $z$ of $\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon]$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], followed by the inverse of the germ isomorphism $k[\epsilon]\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon],z}$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-local-ring]. Then: (a) $\theta^\sharp(a)=\bar a+D_\theta(a)\epsilon$ for a unique map $D_\theta:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to k$; (b) the rule $(a\bmod\mathfrak m_x^2)\mapsto D_\theta(a)$ for $a\in\mathfrak m_x$ is a well-defined $k$-linear map $\ell_\theta:\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2\to k$; (c) $\theta\mapsto\ell_\theta$ is a $k$-linear isomorphism $T_{X/k,x}\to\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2,k)$.

source.place: Tag 0B2E (varieties-lemma-tangent-space-rational-point) with S = Spec k, and the proof of Tag 0B2D (varieties-lemma-tangent-space-cotangent-space): phi(a) = c(a) + D(a) epsilon

proof.text: Because $k[\epsilon]$ has the unique expression $u+v\epsilon$ with $\epsilon^2=0$, and the reduction of $\theta^\sharp$ modulo $(\epsilon)$ is the residue map $a\mapsto\bar a$ (the composite of $\theta$ with the closed point $\operatorname{Spec}k\to\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon]$ is the canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to X$ by [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space], whose local homomorphism in the correspondence of [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-local-ring] is the residue map, and stalk maps of a composite compose by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-stalk-map-composition]), there is a unique function $D_\theta$ with $\theta^\sharp(a)=\bar a+D_\theta(a)\epsilon$. Additivity of $\theta^\sharp$ gives additivity of $D_\theta$, and multiplicativity gives $D_\theta(ab)=\bar aD_\theta(b)+\bar bD_\theta(a)$. Since $\theta$ is a $k$-morphism, $D_\theta$ is $k$-linear on the structure-field copy of $k$ (and hence is a derivation relative to the residue map).

source.place: Tag 0B2D, proof: every element has the form c(a)+D(a) epsilon

proof.text: If $a\in\mathfrak m_x$, then $\bar a=0$, so the coefficient $D_\theta(a)$ depends only on the class of $a$ in $\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2$: for a product $ab$ of two elements of $\mathfrak m_x$, the derivation formula from step 1 gives $D_\theta(ab)=0$, and additivity handles finite sums. Thus $D_\theta$ vanishes on $\mathfrak m_x^2$ and induces $\ell_\theta(a\bmod\mathfrak m_x^2)=D_\theta(a)$. The same additivity and scalar calculation show that $\ell_\theta$ is $k$-linear.

source.place: Tag 0B2E, proof of the tangent-space rational-point identification

proof.text: The assignment $\theta\mapsto\ell_\theta$ is injective because the stalk map $\theta^\sharp$ is recovered from its residue part and the coefficients $D_\theta$ (and a morphism from $\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon]$ is determined by the corresponding local homomorphism by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-local-ring]). For surjectivity, given a $k$-linear $\ell:\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2\to k$, write each $a\in\mathcal O_{X,x}$ as its structure-field residue $\bar a$ plus an element of $\mathfrak m_x$ and define $D(a)$ to be $\ell$ of the latter class. The identities $D(a+b)=D(a)+D(b)$ and $D(ab)=\bar aD(b)+\bar bD(a)$ follow by expanding products into residue-field and maximal-ideal parts; hence $a\mapsto\bar a+D(a)\epsilon$ is a local $k$-algebra map to $k[\epsilon]$, since it sends $\mathfrak m_x$ into $(\epsilon)$. The cited Spec-local-ring correspondence yields a unique tangent vector inducing this map, and its associated functional is $\ell$. Finally, scaling $\epsilon\mapsto\lambda\epsilon$ scales all coefficients by $\lambda$, while the pushout definition of tangent-vector addition adds coefficients, so the bijection is $k$-linear.

D : R → k, (∀ a : R, sharp a = TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((X.residue x).hom a) + TrivSqZeroExt.inr (r (D a))) ∧ (∀ a : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R, e θ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).toCotangent a) = D a)
